standing: TEST-ONLY review data for stage W4 of the A02 package (11 November 2026): the A02 runs with ILLUSTRATIVE carriers added by declared TEST-ONLY treatments, so the gap an approved answer must fill is executable. Every run here is a TEST-ONLY treatment run, never the A02 configuration; every carrier is ILLUSTRATIVE (ours, not knowledge) and lives only in docs/audits/drafts/a02-illustrative. Each case is composed by a02-carriers.unit.ts from A02-0 (its base), the named treatments of a02-inputs.review.json (borrowed unchanged) and the treatments below, and held to the handoff's own validator. Nothing on the live route or the checked pathway reads this file.

words: Testing legitimate configuration alternatives using clearly labeled provisional or illustrative knowledge.
What automated safeguard could have detected this problem before it affected another activity?

treatments.what: the origin clause carried as a begin condition with a state: one START transition, an illustrative pressing line, the pressing team's start placement beyond it re-established at every beginning of an illustrative episode, and the origin condition as a restart taken by a player of the awarded team while that placement holds (in place of RPC-002-02.a and 02.b on the chain's copy only)
treatments.effect: the origin condition's referent is typed, so GA-EPISODE-REACHABLE decides it (the reach, awardee and state clauses) over a TEST-ONLY register copy holding the illustrative episode scope
treatments.why: to make the gap behind the origin clause executable: what an approved answer must supply is the observable start (Q1), the scope (Q-scope) and the structure (Q-structure)
treatments.label: ILLUSTRATIVE: TEST-ONLY carriers of ours, not knowledge; one direction only; never A01's values

treatments.why: to make the gap behind the pressing line executable (Q2)
